question:
(a) What are the 3 (three) types of Co-operative Societies? Mention the minimum members required to form each of the three Co-operative Society.
(b) Write three (3) activities that may be undertaken by a Co-operative.
What are the 5 (five) points that a person can be disqualified from being a member of Co-operative?
Describe in brief the 3 (three) qualifications to become a member of management committee in a Cooperative.
Who can remove the elected member of a management committee? Write down all the procedures to remove the elected member of management committee.

How shall the Employees Contributory Provident Fund in a Co-operative be maintained? Can the quantum of money standing in the credit of any Contributory Provident Fund be used in the business of Co-operative and why?
Who is the authorized officer to wind up Co-operative Society? Mention at least 3 (three) important points that a Co-operative can be wound up.
Write down 5 (five) points on powers of Liquidator.

In which Section of the Mizoram Cooperative Societies Act, 2006(as amended) mention procedure of disposal of surplus Assets? How does the Registrar of Co-operative Societies dispose the surplus assets of wound up Co-operative Society?

Who is the authorized officer to cancel the registration of a Co-operative Society? Explain in brief the method of cancellation process as per Section 116 of the Mizoram Cooperative Societies Act, 2006(as amended).
